source_detail: Base input and output prices: the skill's 'Current Models' table (marked 'cached: 2026-10-06').
Claude Opus 5.5 (shared/model-migration.md): 5-minute cache writes $5, 1-hour cache writes $8, cache reads $0.20 (0.05x base input), batch $2 / $10.

Claude Sonnet 5.5 (shared/model-migration.md): 5-minute cache writes $2.50, 1-hour cache writes $4, cache reads $0.20; batch rates stated only as 'Claude Sonnet 5's batch rates', taken as the general 50% batch rule.

Claude Haiku 5.5 (shared/model-migration.md): $0.10 / $0.50 when the prompt is 100K tokens or fewer, $0.50 / $2.50 when it is longer; cache reads 0.1x, 5-minute cache writes 1.25x and 1-hour cache writes 2x the input rate. The cache figures below are derived from those multipliers.
Claude Fable 5.1 (shared/model-migration.md): 5-minute cache writes $12.50, 1-hour cache writes $20, cache reads $0.25, batch $5 / $25.

Batch discount (shared/cost-optimization.md section 2.5; python/claude-api/batches.md): the Message Batches API charges 50% of standard prices on every token, including cache reads and writes; the discounts stack.
